purpose: Train-only speaker-block label-permutation sanity control for the probabilistic /R/ rater head
permutation: Within each reference outer fold and equal clip-count speaker stratum, order speakers by SHA-256 of seed:fold:clip-count:speaker, then rotate whole ID-sorted five-score-vector blocks by one speaker. Leave singleton strata unchanged.
nestedEvaluation: Recompute the reference v2 inner selection, outer fits, train priors, and target-word baseline on permuted training labels; score permuted holdout labels
